notes.title: Notice - Return of the Guertena Exhibition
notes.content:
[b]"Welcome to the World of Guertena"

We will be showcasing a gallery on the works of the great artist Weiss Guertena.
We hope you deeply enjoy the art of the late Guertena,
whose creations carry such mystery and beauty both.[/b]

"Return of the Guertena Exhibition" is reservations-only.
Please note that the purchasing of tickets is limited to those living in Japan.

Thanks to the overwhelming response to the multiple instances of the Weiss Guertena Exhibition around Japan, the exhibition will return and be held once more in PARCO FACTORY, Ikebukuro.
Return of the Guertena Exhibition will feature all 39 artworks shown in previous exhibitions, as well as 10 more new exhibits.
There will also be a new area where guests can enjoy a brand new viewing experience.

[b]Exhibition Schedule[/b]
- Ikebukuro: July 14 to August 7, 2023
Note: This exhibition is reservation-only.

We will be holding an early visitor ticket lottery during the following period:
- Ikebukuro: June 14 to June 25, 2023 (23:59)

For more details, please refer to [url=https://art.parco.jp/parcomuseum/detail/?id=1240]the official Weiss Guertena Exhibition webpage[/url].
(Japanese only)

Please come visit our strange yet captivating art gallery.

Organizer:
PARCO

Cooperators:
kouri／Active Gaming Media Inc./PLAYISM
